name: Carwash compute reads and updates ordinary ContextDB entities

setup.name: store car make and model
setup.input: My car is a Toyota Camry

requirementSegments: Build me a carwash app that will clean my car.
I can say, "wash my car", "wash my camry" or "wash my toyota".
It will switch my car from dirty to clean.
It will respond "Your car is clean", "Your Camry is clean" or "Your Toyota is clean".
It will update the status from dirty to clean.

steps.name: read Camry status
steps.input: What is the status of my Camry

steps.name: check Toyota condition
steps.input: Is my Toyota clean or dirty?
